cells.C: Week 7 Overview: Using CAQDAS for Analysis II

This week, you will use the CAQDAS program you selected in Week 6 to perform an analysis on a sample data set. If the CAQDAS program has the capability to document the analysis with an audit trail, you will need to perform this function and attach it to your assignment. If the function is not available, you will need to develop an audit framework and capture screen shots of your analysis process to include with your assignment.
